scripts.dev:deno: pnpm run build:library && deno task --config deno.json dev
scripts.dev:cloudflare: pnpm run build:library && pnpm run types:cloudflare && wrangler dev
scripts.test:bun: pnpm run build:library && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.bun.json && bun test ./runtime-tests/bun.test.ts
scripts.test:deno: pnpm run build:library && deno task --config deno.json test
scripts.test:cloudflare: pnpm run build:library && pnpm run types:cloudflare && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.cloudflare.json && vitest run --config vitest.cloudflare.config.ts && pnpm run build:cloudflare
scripts.test:runtimes: pnpm run test:bun && pnpm run test:deno && pnpm run test:cloudflare
